subject: RE: Renewal + Capacity uplift — legal redlines & signoff path
messages:
From: Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@verdantworks.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Park <oliver.park@verdantworks.com>, VerdantWorks Legal <legal@verdantworks.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Nov 2024 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal proposal and uplift questions

Hi Mateo —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. The team liked the proposed 12‑month renewal with the 30% capacity uplift, but legal has a few questions before we can route for internal approval: they want clarity on data retention for dedicated tenants, SLA credits language for burst capacity, and the exact exhibits that lock pricing for the next 12 months.

I've attached the draft order form we received from procurement (Renewal_OrderForm_v2_redlines.pdf). Can you confirm which MSA exhibits will be amended vs. superseded? Also, is there a standard clause you provide for temporary overage protection during onboarding?

Goal: get to a mutual action plan and a DocuSign-ready package by next Wednesday (Dec 4) if possible.

Sasha Kim
Head of Infrastructure — VerdantWorks
Sasha.kim@verdantworks.com

---
Attachment: Renewal_OrderForm_v2_redlines.pdf (pdf)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@verdantworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Dec 2024 08:06:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal proposal and uplift questions

Sasha —

Appreciate the quick summary. Short answers up front:
- Dedicated tenant data retention remains customer‑configurable; our default is 90 days for request logs and 365 days for audit trail (we can change per SOW).
- SLA credits: we provide a tiered credit schedule tied to monthly availability; for uplift/onboarding overages we can include a 30‑day buffer with no overage charges up to 10% of committed capacity.
- Pricing lock: Exhibit B (Capacity Schedule) and Exhibit D (Rate Card) are the documents we amend. Exhibit A (Services SOW) stays as reference unless scope changes.

I'm looping in Marissa to propose precise redlines for the MSA and order form. Ben — can you draft the minimal language for the onboarding overage protection?

Next steps: Marissa will upload a marked MSA and an order form with inline comments to the shared drive and propose the DocuSign envelope. Sasha — if you can confirm VerdantWorks legal's preference on the 90 vs 365 day retention windows, we'll reflect that in the MSA mark.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 03 Dec 2024 10:28:00 -0800
Subject: MSA + Order form redlines (first pass)

Team / Sasha —

I reviewed VerdantWorks' attached order form and prepared an MSA with tracked changes. High‑level callouts:

1) Data retention: I propose we offer the 90/365 default with an optional customer checkbox in Exhibit A to extend logs to 730 days at an incremental rate — keeps flexibility and avoids blanket commitments.
2) Overage protection: Drafted a short clause for a 30‑day onboarding grace period; called it "Temporary Onboard Protection" and limited it to one occurrence per renewal term.
3) Pricing lock: Marked Exhibit B to show the capacity tiers and included an explicit definition of "Committed Capacity" to avoid interpretation issues.

I've attached: MSA_2024_marked_changes.docx and a revised order form with inline comments. Please review and flag anything legal must negotiate.

Marissa
Director, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: MSA_2024_marked_changes.docx (docx)

From: Oliver Park <oliver.park@verdantworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: VerdantWorks Legal <legal@verdantworks.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Dec 2024 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA + Order form redlines (first pass)

Marissa / Mateo —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of notes from our legal and infra team after an initial pass:
- The 90/365 default is acceptable; legal asked that the 730 option include a simple amendment process (signed email confirmation is fine).
- Legal wants more specificity around the SLA credit calculation for partial‑month outages during capacity ramps — they requested an example formula.
- We also asked for a short statement confirming that KV cache data used only for inference will not be retained beyond session limits (they're worried about PII traces during caching).

Can Redwood provide the SLA example and a one‑paragraph cache retention statement we can put into Exhibit C?

Oliver Park
VP, Platform — VerdantWorks

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Park <oliver.park@verdantworks.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, VerdantWorks Legal <legal@verdantworks.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Dec 2024 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA + Order form redlines (first pass)

Oliver / team —

Draft SLA example below — please confirm if this meets your sample need and we'll convert to legal phrasing: 

"SLA credit example: If committed availability for a calendar month is 99.9% and measured availability is 99.6%, the monthly credit equals (99.9% - 99.6%) / 99.9% * monthly committed fee. For partial‑month capacity ramps, credits are prorated based on days at each capacity tier."

Cache retention paragraph suggestion: 
"KV cache used to accelerate inference is ephemeral and scoped per inference session. Redwood does not persist user prompt or inference output traces beyond configured session TTLs; customers may enable extended retention per Exhibit A at additional cost. Redwood will not use cached inference data for model training or external analytics."

If that looks good, Marissa and I will integrate legal‑grade language and produce a redline for Exhibit C.

Ben Carter
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: VerdantWorks Legal <legal@verdantworks.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Oliver Park <oliver.park@verdantworks.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Dec 2024 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: MSA + Order form redlines (first pass) — confirmation and minor edits

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the sample language. The SLA formula is acceptable; please embed the example in Exhibit D with a worked illustration using VerdantWorks' expected monthly committed fee (we'll share numbers once legal has the embedded example). The cache paragraph is helpful — proposed tweak below to be explicit about PII: 

"KV cache is ephemeral and session‑scoped. Redwood will not persist or use KV cache contents containing customer PII beyond the session TTL; customers may request longer retention in writing as set out in Exhibit A."

Last item: VerdantWorks prefers that the onboarding grace (30‑day protection) is applied automatically on renewal if capacity increases exceed 20% of prior term committed capacity. If Redwood cannot accept automatic application, please propose a short process right (signed email) to enable it.

If Redwood can accept the change or provide a short process we can agree to, we'll route for internal eSign and aim to complete signature by EOD Friday.

Regards,
VerdantWorks Legal
legal@verdantworks.com
